name: EnvZ-OmpR two-component signalling
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Shinar and Feinberg, Science 327, 1389 (2010), doi:10.1126/science.1183372: the EnvZ-OmpR mechanism; reactions and rate constants as in Anderson, Enciso and Johnston, J. R. Soc. Interface 11, 20130943 (2014), Fig. 2 (arXiv:1310.3761)

assumptions: mass action; ADP and ATP constant and absorbed in the rates (as in the source)
the rate constants are those of the reproduction by Anderson, Enciso and Johnston (the original was not read)
free EnvZ and free OmpR written through the totals Xtot and Ytot, so that a step of the total OmpR is a step of a parameter

drift.XD: -k1*XD + k2*D*(Xtot - XD - XT - Xp - XpY - XDYp) - k9*XD*Yp + k10*XDYp + k11*XDYp
drift.XT: k3*T*(Xtot - XD - XT - Xp - XpY - XDYp) - k4*XT - k5*XT
drift.Xp: k5*XT - k6*Xp*(Ytot - XpY - XDYp - Yp) + k7*XpY
drift.XpY: k6*Xp*(Ytot - XpY - XDYp - Yp) - k7*XpY - k8*XpY
